title: 3D Models
author: praneth2580
headline: Motorcycle gear you can print yourself, free to download
intro: Open-source, parametric 3D-printable designs: a phone navigation dock and a round display pod for motorcycles, general purpose and adjustable for any bike and your own hardware. Download the STLs, or change the measurements and make your own.
disclaimer: Prototypes, not road-tested products. Mount anything on a vehicle so it never blocks the steering, controls or your view, and follow your local rules.
